command: set -u; SERIAL='RFCT70L7E8J'; PKG='io.blueeye'; XML='/tmp/tracker-alert-v5.xml'; dump(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-alert-v5.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 && adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out cat /sdcard/tracker-alert-v5.xml > "$XML"; }; coords(){ python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null; }; retry_coords(){ attr=$1; value=$2; tries=${3:-5}; out=''; i=1; while [ $i -le $tries ]; do dump || true; out=$(coords "$attr" "$value" || true); echo alerts_coords=$c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $c; sleep 2; initial=$(master_state || true); echo detection_initial=$initial; test "$initial" = false || exit 24; mc=$(master_coords || true); test -n "$mc" || exit 25; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $mc; sleep 2; enabled=$(master_state || true); echo detection_enabled=$enabled; test "$enabled" = true || exit 26; test_coords=''; i=1; while [ $i -le 5 ]; if [ -n "$test_coords" ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $test_coords; sleep 2; fi; before=$(active_test_count); echo active_test_notification_before_disable=$before; uid=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package "$PKG" | awk -F= '/userId=/{gsub(/\r/,"",$2); process=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PKG" | tr -d '\r'); echo app_pid=$process; test -n "$test_coords" || exit 31; test "$before" -ge 1 || exit 32; test -n "$mc" || exit 33; test "$after" -eq 0 || exit 34; test "$final" = false || exit 35; test -n "$process" || exit 36; echo PHASE3_ALERT_S22_DETECTION_OFF_ACCEPTANCE_PASS
